title: Level 0.5 Summary Schema
description: Structured Level 0.5 summary of a single philosophical source: core thesis, argument route, key concepts, interlocutors, and topic tags. Produced by phil-summarize; written to Private/Bibliography/Summaries/ by /phil:ingest.

summary_id.description: Unique identifier with SUM- prefix (see report-id-registry.md)

bib_key.description: The INDEX.md KEY this summary belongs to (AUTHOR-TITLE format)

title.description: Complete title as read from the title page

year.description: 4-digit year read from the PDF, or "nd" if unverifiable

source_location.description: Canonical PDF path relative to Private/Bibliography/ (e.g. PDF/Austin_1956_A-Plea-for-Excuses.pdf)

core_thesis.description: The core claim the text commits itself to, stated charitably

argument_route.description: Ordered sketch of the major argumentative moves (route map, not full reconstruction)

interlocutors.description: Named positions or authors the text substantively engages with

topics.description: English lowercase topic tags aligned with the INDEX Topics column vocabulary

summary_text.description: Rendered Chinese summary, ~300-500 characters, covering all five elements

year_verified.description: True only if the year was read from the PDF itself (Rule 2 provenance)
